title: Patron demon
kicker: Roster and summoning · summon and fusion
hook: **WIP:** name one demon your **patron** so its element colours the army — switching costs souls.

blindSpots.meaning: Designed and partly forged. Simulation paths exist; the live lawn aura is still unfinished.
One chosen specimen whose element tints side presence — not a second commander title by itself.
Element identity across your side — paired with the [element ring](element-ring), not a cosmetic nickname only.
Changing patron spends souls. Read the UI when it ships; do not assume it is free.

alsoTrue: Commanders are a separate WIP layer for who leads the next lawn — see [commanders](commanders).
You still play without a finished patron path.

sections.title: What it will be
paras: Pick one demon from the roster as patron.
Its element becomes the army’s tint; changing that choice costs souls.

sections.title: In this build
paras: The patron idea exists in simulation.
The live lawn aura and full player flow are still WIP — do not expect a finished patron button on every stage.

sections.title: Why it matters later
paras: Without a patron, element identity is only on individual specimens.
With one, the side carries a readable elemental story into lawn and battles.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Raise specimens and learn elements on the roster.
Treat any partial patron UI as unfinished.
Use commanders and fusion as they exist today without waiting on patron.
doNote: Stop when patron ≠ commander is clear. Other intakes: [wild joins](wild-joins), [capture](capture).

mixUps.q: Is patron the same as commander?
mixUps.a: No. Patron colours element identity; commanders pick who leads a lawn run.
Design is one patron. Do not plan multi-patron loadouts.

mixUps.q: Is my build broken without it?
mixUps.a: No. WIP means unfinished, not required to open the game.
No. Essence remains fusion’s element material.
